Areas of Practice

The development and complexity of the Law matters in a globalized world makes specialization and sub-specialization of Attorneys-at-Law a “must” necessary in the several fields of Law. Under this perspective the members of CAMYA have become high-quality specialists in diverse legal areas such as:

  • Civil and Commercial litigation and consultancy
  • Administrative litigation and consultancy
  • Tax and Foreign Trade litigation and consultancy
  • Constitutional Litigation
    (Amparo, Constitutional Controversies, Actions of Unconstitutionality)
  • Strategic Administrative litigation and consultancy
    (Anti-money Laundering, Anti-corruption and Personal Data Protection)
  • Private Mediation
  • Corporate Governance
  • Corporate Law in general
  • Contracts and Agreements
  • Commercial Bankruptcy
  • Mergers & Acquisitions
  • Agrarian Law
  • Infrastructure
  • Energy
  • Real Estate
  • Environmental Law
  • Health Law
  • Mining Law
  • Public Procurement
  • Gaming and Raffles
  • State Liability
  • Responsibility of Public Officials
  • Foreign Investment
  • Transportation and Logistics
  • Intellectual Property
  • Wills and Estates
  • Corporate Regimes
  • Antitrust Law
  • Migration Law
  • Consumer Protection and Protection to Users of Financial Services

Our members are lawyers with a firm conviction in a legal practice where public and private norms of honesty and legality must be respected.

At CAMYA, we believe that the time of individuals and institutions is very valuable; therefore, we are committed to ensuring that our clients will be attended to with due diligence and timeliness.

Furthermore, CAMYA is dedicated to gaining an in-depth understanding of the industries and sectors of our clients to deliver customized legal services with timely and meticulous attention to their needs. Our approach involves cultivating a clear business vision that enhances the value of their activities.

Our commitment extends towards providing comprehensive and optimal solutions to their challenges while implementing proactive strategies to prevent conflicts. CAMYA operates as a legal firm devoted to delivering services of excellence, consistently adhering to national and international ethical standards. Our unwavering dedication is directed towards benefiting our clients and society at large.

Legal strength. Business vision.
